title: Brick Haven | Hot Tub, Cold Plunge & Sauna Vibes
description:
Welcome to your luxury wellness townhome in Nashville. This fully furnished, high-end retreat offers 4 private en-suite bedrooms, a sleek modern aesthetic, and an expansive open-concept living space designed for comfort and connection. Indulge in premium, spa-level amenities including a private sauna, cold plunge, and a rooftop hot tub with breathtaking skyline views. Every detail of this home is curated to deliver an exceptional, five-star experience.

The space
Luxury Townhome with Rooftop Hot Tub, Cold Plunge & Sauna

Welcome to your fully furnished, ultra-luxury townhome just minutes from the heart of downtown Nashville. Thoughtfully designed for both style and comfort, this exceptional retreat features four spacious bedrooms, each with its own private en-suite bathroom—ideal for groups, families, or friends traveling together.

The interior showcases sleek modern finishes, a cozy fireplace, and an open-concept layout perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Elevate your stay with premium wellness amenities, including a private sauna and a rooftop hot tub where you can unwind while enjoying breathtaking panoramic views of the Nashville skyline. We've even got a Tesla level 2 EV charger for you!

Floor Layout:
• 1st floor: Bunk bedroom
• 2nd floor: Guest bedroom with adjacent living area
• 3rd floor: Primary bedroom plus additional guest bedroom
• 4th floor: Private sauna and outdoor deck

Every detail has been carefully curated to deliver a truly elevated experience, blending luxury, convenience, and unforgettable city views. Whether you’re visiting to explore Music City or simply relax in style, this one-of-a-kind townhome offers the perfect setting for a memorable stay.

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is generally quiet and safe, it’s important to remember that this is an urban environment. We encourage you to stay mindful of your surroundings and practice common sense. For your safety, we recommend not leaving valuables in your car and ensuring that doors and windows are securely locked whenever you leave the house.
